nodes.label: Gastos App capability (gastos-app)
nodes.rationale: First app under the corrected nav model: subtree at /CxP/gastos/ with its own MainLayout (not the shell layout), Dashboard landing gated by auth only, three-step login, cross-app SSO, reusable GastosRoutes module.

nodes.label: Gastos Three-Step Login
nodes.rationale: Steps: credentials, password+domain, empresa/sucursal/area context; step 3 is Gastos-ONLY (corrects the foundation's inverse claim); session not finalized until step 3.

nodes.label: Cross-App Single Sign-On
nodes.rationale: Within the shell build (single origin), Gastos shares the session established by the global login; hub→gastos requires no re-authentication.
